dct_description_sm: In extremely ice-rich zones, studies show that CCR surveys exhibit lower resistivity values than traditional direct current (DC) electrical profiling methods. Previous mountain permafrost studies (Hauck and Kneisel, 2006) propose that the difference between the outputs of the two systems may be used as an indicator for ice content. To our knowledge, this is the first study to i) compare CCR and DC outputs in an ice-rich periglacial permafrost landscape, and ii) compare the results of the two systems with identical antenna configurations.
dct_title_s: Comparison between capacitively-coupled resistivity and direct current resistivity profiling methods in ice-rich permafrost terrain, Herschel Island
